title: Feedback in learning skills
log: 2026-10-29T12:14:25Z write: the API refused it in the chapter request, so it is written on its own next

draft.title: Feedback in learning skills
card: information a performer senses from their own body during or after a movement, such as the feel of a smooth swing.
information from outside the performer, such as a coach's comment, a video replay or a scoreboard.
feedback about the outcome of the skill, such as the distance thrown or whether the ball went in.
feedback about how the movement itself was done, such as the elbow dropping during a throw.
draft.remember: Feedback has a source (inside or outside the performer) and a focus (the outcome or the movement).

a.q: After a netball shot misses, the coach says, "Your knees were straight when you released the ball." What type of feedback is this?
a.why: The coach is outside the performer, so it is external. The comment describes how the movement was done, so it is knowledge of performance. It is not about results, because it does not report the outcome of the shot.
a.clue: Who gave the feedback, and what did it describe?

b.q: Priya bowls a cricket ball. A speed gun shows 98 km/h on a screen. Which type of feedback does this give her?
b.why: The screen is outside Priya, so the feedback is external. The speed is an outcome of the delivery, so it is knowledge of results. It is tempting to call it performance, but it says nothing about how her body moved.
b.clue: Does the number describe the outcome or her movement?
